title: Promise and Garden
premise: Ivo Voss, a pastry chef three missed payments from losing her café, agrees to pose as the girlfriend of Elias Marchetti—a childhood friend turned hotel heir—to survive his grandmother's reunion, where his family expects him to announce his engagement to a merger-approved bride. What begins as a transactional lie deepens over one weekend of shared history, until Elias's father offers Ivo the catering contract of a lifetime on the condition she walk away. In the end, Ivo refuses the gilded cage, signs a partnership with her own staff instead, and Elias chooses her over the family name, the two of them reopening her café's garden terrace together as the lease is saved.
about_author: August Amberdale is the pen name of a former pastry line cook who traded early mornings at the oven for early mornings at the desk. She writes love stories set in kitchens, believing that the truest confessions happen over dessert.

chapters.title: The Terms of the Lie
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Facing a final notice on the café lease, Ivo agrees when Elias Marchetti offers to pay off her debts in exchange for playing his girlfriend at his grandmother's reunion. They negotiate rules like a contract, but his easy familiarity unsettles her. Emotional beat: guarded pragmatism cracking with the first flicker of old affection.

chapters.title: Reunion in the Rose Garden
chapters.summary: Elias's POV. The reunion begins: sharp-eyed relatives, a rival fiancée candidate named Bianca, and a grandmother who sees through everything but says nothing. When Elias and Ivo improvise a story about how they met, the lie starts feeling like memory. Emotional beat: the fake romance becoming indistinguishable from the real thing.

chapters.title: Dessert and Leverage
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. At the reunion's final dinner, Ivo's pastries steal the evening—and catch the eye of Elias's father, who offers her a lucrative hotel contract contingent on ending things with Elias and signing an exclusivity that would swallow her independence. Elias, overhearing, assumes she'll take it. Emotional beat: betrayal and the temptation of security over love.

chapters.title: What the Garden Grows Back
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Ivo refuses the contract and, instead of accepting Elias's money, pitches her staff on a cooperative to save the café. Elias confronts his father and walks away from the merger, arriving at the café as the lease deadline passes—only to find Ivo already fighting, and winning. Emotional beat: two people choosing each other and themselves, ending on the garden terrace's first open night.
